selector.rationale: The presence of a focal hypoechoic polypoidal lesion and a left hydrosalpinx supports the diagnosis of endometriosis, which is a known cause of such lesions and is often associated with pelvic abnormalities.

rejected.label: Malacoplakia of the Urinary Bladder
rejected.why: The presence of a well-defined soft-tissue-density lesion with calcific specks is not typical for malacoplakia, which usually presents with more diffuse and infiltrative lesions.

rejected.label: Urinary Bladder Carcinoma
rejected.why: While hematuria is a common symptom of bladder cancer, the imaging findings and the presence of a left hydrosalpinx are more suggestive of endometriosis.

rejected.label: Schistosomiasis of the Urinary Bladder
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings do not strongly support schistosomiasis, which typically presents with more chronic and diffuse bladder involvement.
